q: What does Attribix do, in one sentence?
a: It shows you which of your Facebook, Instagram and Google ads bring you customers, and makes sure your sales are counted correctly.

q: Which online stores does Attribix work with?
a: Shopify stores, including Shopify Plus. You install Attribix from the Shopify App Store. Other store platforms are not supported.

q: Why are Attribix numbers different from Facebook or Google?
a: Facebook and Google count sales their own way. Both can count the same order. Some also count people who only saw an ad and bought later. Attribix starts from the real orders in your Shopify store and counts each one once. The difference shows how much extra credit the platforms may be taking.

q: How does Attribix count sales correctly?
a: Your store reports each sale to Facebook and Google from the shopper's browser. Attribix also reports it from a server, which ad blockers can't stop. Both reports carry the same ID number, so the sale is only counted once. In technical terms: browser and server-side tracking with event deduplication, using the Meta Conversions API and Google's own conversion IDs.

q: What is attribution, and which options do I get?
a: Attribution is the rule for which ad gets credit when a customer saw more than one. You can compare four rules: the last ad clicked (last click), the first ad clicked (first click), an equal share for every ad (linear), and more credit to recent clicks (time-decay). You can set last click, first click or linear as your default in Settings.

Attribix respects your visitors' cookie choices through Google Consent Mode v2. It also follows Shopify's rules for customer data requests and deletions. Our Privacy Policy explains what is collected and how it is used.
You can download your customer list as a file ready for Google Ads Customer Match, so you can reach past buyers. If you need other data, email us at hello@attribix.app.

q: Do refunds change the sales numbers?
a: No. Attribix records the order total at the moment of purchase. If an order is refunded or changed later, Attribix does not update it. In months with many refunds, check your Shopify reports as well.
